name: event_id
notes: Unique identifier for this train passage event

name: site_id
notes: Site name

name: event_t0_utc
notes: Shared event reference time for all modalities

name: created_utc
notes: NetCDF creation timestamp

name: pipeline_version
notes: Pipeline version from config

name: software_git_hash
notes: Currently set to N/A

name: query_start_date
notes: Only when metadata inclusion is enabled

name: query_end_date
notes: Only when metadata inclusion is enabled

name: query_train_type_filter
notes: Filter used to fetch events

name: query_track_filter
notes: Filter used to fetch events

name: query_timezone
notes: Time basis used during query

name: acc_axis
notes: Fixed accelerometer axis count

name: fo_channel
notes: Present only when FO data exists

name: train_type
notes: Train classification

name: event_start_offset_s
notes: Event start offset relative to event_t0_utc

name: event_end_offset_s
notes: Event end offset relative to event_t0_utc

name: train_speed_kmh
notes: Train speed from source DB

name: track_number
notes: Track number from source DB; missing_value = -1

name: acc_sensor
notes: Number of accelerometer sensors in event

name: acc_sensor_id
notes: Stable sensor IDs such as MP1 or MP6

name: axis_labels
notes: Usually x y z

name: acc_distance_to_track_m
notes: Sensor distance to track

name: acc_side_of_track
notes: Convention: -1 left 0 unknown +1 right

name: axis_mask
notes: Global per-sensor axis availability mask

name: acc_time
notes: Time samples for this specific sensor

name: time_s
notes: Relative to event_t0_utc

name: fs_hz
notes: Sensor sampling frequency

name: axis_mask
notes: Per-sensor axis mask for this group

name: velocity_mms
notes: Velocity time series (x y z); free-field sensors only (e.g. MP1-MP13)

name: acceleration_g
notes: Acceleration time series (x y z) in g; in-track sensors only (e.g. MP14-MP19); mutually exclusive with velocity_mms

name: fo_reader
notes: FO reader type (for example optasense); only when FO found

name: fo_file_count
notes: Number of concatenated FO files

name: acquisition_id
notes: FO acquisition ID from file metadata when available

name: gauge_length
notes: FO gauge length from file metadata or manual fallback

name: gauge_length_unit
notes: Unit for gauge_length

name: spatial_sampling_interval
notes: FO spatial sampling interval from file metadata or manual fallback

name: spatial_sampling_interval_unit
notes: Unit for spatial_sampling_interval

name: raw_data_unit
notes: Raw FO data unit from file metadata

name: raw_description
notes: Raw FO data description from file metadata

name: fibre_refractive_index
notes: Fibre refractive index from file metadata

name: number_of_measurements
notes: Number of FO samples in source measurement

name: centre_fo_channel
notes: Configured center FO channel

name: fo_channel_half_window
notes: Channels taken on each side of center

name: fo_side_of_track
notes: Convention: -1 left 0 unknown +1 right

name: fo_aprox_distance_to_track_m
notes: Approximate FO distance to track centerline

name: fo_channel_id
notes: Absolute channel numbers

name: fo_channel_position_m
notes: Currently literal channel values no distance conversion

name: fo_channel_spacing_m
notes: Optional from FO metadata when available

name: fo_gauge_length_m
notes: Optional from FO metadata when available

name: fo_first_channel
notes: First absolute FO channel index selected from the DAS array; optional

name: fo_last_channel
notes: Last absolute FO channel index selected from the DAS array; optional

name: fo_time
notes: FO time samples in event window

name: time_s
notes: Relative to event_t0_utc

name: fs_hz
notes: FO sampling frequency

name: strain
notes: Raw FO strain window around center channel
